LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS is made up of passionate players who advance the art & science of game development through great stories, great gameplay, and advanced technology. We are focused on bringing next generation experiences to gamers who want to enjoy them anywhere, anytime, across multiple genres and devices.

What the Role Entails
About the role We're an incubation team inside Lightspeed Studios chasing original IP with high replayability value. We move fast: idea → playable prototype → playtest → next idea. We're looking for an intern who can sit at the intersection of design and code, turning gameplay hypotheses into things people can actually click on within days, not weeks.
 
关于这个岗位
我们是光子旗下的一个孵化团队,专注于挖掘有原创 IP 潜质、高耐玩度的游戏方向。
节奏很快:想法 → 可玩原型 → 试玩 → 下一个想法。我们想找一位能在策划和开发之间游走的实习生，能把脑子里的玩法概念，几天内变成大家能上手玩的东西，而不是花上几周。
This is not a production role. The bar is "fun enough to validate," not "ready to ship." If you've spent weekends building prototypes for game jams just to see whether a weird mechanic works, you'll feel at home here.
这不是量产岗位。我们的标准是"好玩到能验证方向"，而不是"可以上线发售"。如果你周末闲不下来，经常做点 Game Jam 原型，就为了看看一个怪点子能不能 work，那你来对地方了。
 
What you'll do
Design and prototype gameplay mechanics across genres, with a focus on replayability and IP potential
Spin up playable web prototypes in Phaser.js / HTML5 / JS — fast, dirty, and instructive
Run informal playtests with the team, distil what's fun (and what isn't), and feed findings back into the next iteration
Produce light design docs — enough to communicate intent, not enough to drown in
Collaborate with the design lead on weekly experiments aligned to incubation themes
你会做什么
跨品类设计并原型化玩法机制,重点验证耐玩度和 IP 潜力
用 Phaser.js / HTML5 / JS 快速搭建网页端可玩原型 — 快、糙、有效
在团队内组织非正式试玩,提炼出"什么好玩、什么不好玩"，反哺下一轮迭代
写轻量级的设计文档 — 把思路讲清楚即可,不用堆字数
跟策划 Lead 配合，围绕孵化主题做每周的玩法实验

Who We Look For
What we're looking forHands-on prototyping skills in Phaser.js, JavaScript, and HTML5 (or a comparable web/lightweight stack you can pivot from quickly)
A portfolio of personal projects, game jam entries, or school work that shows you can take an idea from concept to playable
Strong design instincts — you can articulate why a mechanic feels fun, not just describe what it does
Comfort with ambiguity and rapid iteration; you're energised by short loops and don't need a fully written spec to start
Curiosity about what makes games replayable — roguelikes, party games, autobattlers, deckbuilders, whatever the genre
我们在找什么样的人
有 Phaser.js、JavaScript、HTML5 的实战原型开发能力：或其他能快速上手的轻量级 Web 技术栈
有作品集：个人项目、Game Jam 作品或学校作业都行,能证明你能把一个想法做成可玩的东西
有设计直觉：你能讲清楚一个机制"为什么好玩",而不只是"它是什么"
习惯模糊和快速迭代：不用别人给你写好详尽的 spec,你也能自驱开干,而且乐在其中
对"什么让游戏耐玩"有真心的好奇：无论是 肉鸽、派对游戏、自走棋、卡牌构筑，什么品类都行
Bonus points
You use AI-assisted dev tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) in your workflow
Game jam wins or notable releases (itch.io, Steam, App Store)
Familiarity with replay-driven systems: procgen, meta-progression, asymmetric matchmaking, live-ops loops
Some art / audio / UX chops to make prototypes feel a notch above programmer-art
加分项
工作流里已经在用 AI 辅助开发工具(Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot)
Game Jam 获奖经历,或在 itch.io / Steam / App Store 上有上线作品
熟悉耐玩驱动的系统设计：程序化生成、局外成长、非对称匹配、长线运营循环
有点美术 / 音频 / UX 的底子，能让原型看起来比"程序员美术"高那么一档
Logistics
Location: Singapore, on-site at Lightspeed Studios
Duration: open — tell us your availability
Reports to: Senior Game Designer, Incubation
To apply: send a portfolio link with 2–3 prototypes you're proud of and a short note on why this role fits

Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
1. Migration Architecture Design & Hands-on Implementation:
Design architecture migration solutions for public cloud customers. Focus on deep technical implementation for migrating overseas mainstream stacks (BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, etc.) to Tencent Cloud WeData + DLC/EMR (storage-compute separation architecture). Deploy migration environments, execute data synchronization, and perform business cutovers on the front line.
2. End-to-End Project Management & Delivery: Take ownership of the overall project schedule, risk control, and technical solution governance. Coordinate internal and external resources to overcome organizational and technical barriers, ensuring the successful final delivery of the migration project.
3. Process Assurance & Technical Support: Act as the primary technical point of contact for troubleshooting and resolving complex issues during migration. Ensure a fast and smooth transition to the cloud by managing data consistency, business continuity, and providing comprehensive technical guidance.
4. Deep Technical Optimization: Provide full-stack technical support, including but not limited to SQL syntax automated conversion/rewriting, Spark/Flink operator tuning, and post-migration performance benchmarking. Ensure that business performance on Tencent Cloud meets or exceeds expectations.
5. Product-Research Collaboration & Best Practices: Work closely with Solution Architects (SA) to professionally summarize and feed back real-world customer requirements, pain points, and tool defects. Assist SAs in refining migration roadmaps and co-authoring "Best Practice Manuals" for migrating from overseas cloud platforms to Tencent Cloud.

Who We Look For
1. Hardcore Technical Background: Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science or related fields; 5+ years of experience in Big Data. Proficient in at least one programming language (Java, Scala, or Python) with strong coding skills and logic conversion capabilities.
2. Overseas Stack Expertise: Familiar with the architecture and use cases of at least one major product: BigQuery, Databricks, or Snowflake. Understand the differences between these and open-source ecosystems (Spark, Hive); cross-cloud migration experience is a plus.
3. System Analysis & Large-scale Management: Strong capability in system problem analysis and resolving complex architectural issues. Proven experience in cluster performance tuning, troubleshooting, source code optimization, and version upgrades; experience managing large-scale clusters (1000+ nodes) is preferred.
4. Migration Delivery Experience: Extensive experience in Big Data migration implementation and management. Master common migration workflows and methodologies for big data components. Familiar with mainstream vendor platforms and a proven track record of delivering large-scale cloud migration projects (PB-level).
5. Core Component Principles: Deep understanding of the Hadoop ecosystem, with source-code level or deep tuning experience in HDFS, Yarn, Spark, Hive, Flink, Doris, Iceberg/Hudi, etc. Capable of handling underlying compatibility issues in heterogeneous environments.
6. Soft Skills & Professionalism: Excellent customer service awareness, communication, and resource coordination skills. Proactive, self-driven, and highly responsible. Able to thrive under pressure in cross-cloud and overseas migration scenarios.

Corporate Development Group (CDG) as the platform for the company's new business incubation and new business exploration, CDG is responsible for promoting development and innovation for important areas such as financial technology and advertising, as well as marketing services, including payment and financial applications. As a professional support platform, CDG also supports the company and various business groups in strategic planning, investments and mergers, investor relations and corporate global communications, marketing and public relations, and more.

What the Role Entails
Core Objective:
To spearhead the acquisition of new performance advertising clients in the Europe markets. The role involves managing the full sales cycle from lead generation to deal closure, contributing to team revenue, building a robust client pipeline, and assisting in the development of overseas sales systems and industry-specific capabilities.
Key Responsibilities：
Lead Generation & Prospecting: Proactively identify and engage potential advertisers (with a focus on Mobile Games, Apps, etc.) through various channels including external ecosystem partnerships, industry summits, online research, and partner referrals.
Client Engagement & Insight: Conduct high-quality client meetings (online/offline) to gain deep insights into their business objectives and advertising needs. Effectively communicate the value proposition of Tencent AMS overseas solutions.
Sales Pitching & Negotiation: Lead the creation and presentation of sales pitches, manage the negotiation process, and oversee the entire cycle until contract signing and client onboarding.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Operations, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure client requirements are accurately understood and implemented, resolving any issues during the initial onboarding phase.
Pipeline Management & Reporting: Maintain disciplined management of leads and opportunities within the CRM system. Provide regular reports on pipeline status, sales forecasts, and key metrics (e.g., Lead-to-Close rate, sales cycle length).
Internal Ecosystem Synergy: Establish collaborative relationships with other internal business units focused on international expansion to share resources and achieve win-win outcomes.

Who We Look For
Experience: 5+ years of experience in overseas performance advertising (Programmatic Advertising preferred) sales or business development. Proven track record of acquiring clients from "0 to 1." Familiarity with Games, E-commerce, or Brand Export industries is a plus.
Skills: Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills. Strong self-drive and goal-oriented mindset, with the ability to work independently in an uncertain environment.
Knowledge: Deep understanding of performance advertising concepts, programmatic buying, and mobile attribution. Familiarity with data privacy regulations such as GDPR/CCPA is preferred.
Languages: Full professional proficiency in English (working language). Proficiency in local languages of the target markets (e.g., German, French, Arabic, etc.) is highly preferred.
Others: Capability to work across different time zones; possesses a strong sense of teamwork and an entrepreneurial spirit.

2064910540509196288.RecruitPostName: Tencent Cloud Senior Industry Product Operations Manager — Risk Control & Anti-Fraud (Malaysia)
2064910540509196288.Responsibility:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
We are looking for a (Senior) Industry Product Operations Manager with solid experience in risk control, anti-fraud, business security, and financial risk management, as well as strong commercialisation capabilities and bilingual communication skills in native language and English.
This role will be responsible for supporting the commercialisation and solution delivery of Tencent Cloud Risk Control Solution, TCRS, in overseas markets. The position will serve as a critical bridge between product, sales, solution, delivery, and client teams.
The successful candidate will be expected to deeply understand overseas clients’ risk challenges across scenarios such as registration, login, marketing campaigns, transactions, payments, credit application, account security, and user lifecycle management. The candidate will translate Tencent Cloud’s capabilities in business security, risk identification, anti-fraud, device risk, account security, payment risk control, and financial risk management into industry solutions that are sellable, deliverable, and scalable.
This role requires not only strong technical understanding, but also strong business acumen, client communication skills, and solution packaging capabilities. The candidate will support overseas sales teams throughout the full sales cycle, including requirement discovery, solution design, client presentation, product demonstration, POC execution, pricing support, and commercial conversion.1. Drive Overseas Commercialisation of TCRSLead the solution design and commercial landing of Tencent Cloud TCRS products in overseas markets, covering risk control, anti-fraud, and financial risk management.
Develop industry-specific solutions for clients in fintech, digital banking, consumer finance, payments, e-commerce, gaming, content platforms, and social networking.
Translate TCRS capabilities, including device risk, account security, transaction risk control, payment risk control, credit risk control, rule engines, and model scoring, into clear business value that clients can understand.
2. Support the End-to-End Overseas Sales ProcessSupport sales, business development, and channel teams in client requirement discovery, solution design, technical engagement, product demonstration, POC execution, and pricing support.
Independently conduct product introductions, solution walkthroughs, technical Q&A, and value presentations to clients in both native language and English.
Help identify clients’ real pain points, purchasing motivations, and decision-making processes, and drive opportunities from the requirement stage to POC, quotation, and contract signing.
3. Design Anti-Fraud and Business Security SolutionsAnalyse client risk issues and design solutions across scenarios such as registration, login, marketing, transactions, payments, and account security.
Cover typical risk cases including fake registration, account theft, marketing abuse, promotion abuse, card-not-present fraud, chargebacks, account takeover, and organised fraud.
Design localised risk control solutions by combining capabilities such as device risk, behavioural risk, IP risk, account risk, relationship networks, rules, and machine learning models.
4. Support Financial Risk Management SolutionsDesign pre-loan, in-loan, and post-loan risk management solutions for financial clients, including digital banks, consumer finance companies, cash loan providers, BNPL platforms, payment institutions, and e-wallets.
Cover key scenarios such as identity verification, application fraud detection, credit assessment, credit approval, limit management, transaction monitoring, post-loan early warning, and collection segmentation.
Support financial clients in POC test design, performance evaluation, strategy optimisation, and business value assessment.
5. Drive Product Requirement ClosureCollect overseas client requirements related to anti-fraud, payment risk control, credit risk management, and compliance risk management, and translate them into product requirements and implementation roadmaps.
Work closely with product, R&D, algorithm, data, delivery, and sales teams to convert client requirements into product capabilities.
Consolidate project experience from key accounts and develop standardised industry solutions, case studies, POC templates, and sales enablement tools.
6. Sales Enablement and Market InsightsDeliver product training, industry training, case study training, and competitor training to sales, business development, channel, and partner teams.
Produce materials such as product introductions, industry solution decks, client case studies, FAQs, competitor analysis, and deployment documentation.
Track overseas trends in risk control, anti-fraud, fintech, and compliance, and provide input to support the overseas GTM strategy of TCRS.

Who We Look For
Bachelor’s degree or above; 
Minimum 5 years of experience in internet risk control, anti-fraud, business security, fintech risk management, payment risk control, credit risk management, or related fields.
Excellent bilingual communication skills in native language and English, with the ability to conduct client communication, solution presentations, business discussions, document drafting, and cross-border team collaboration in English. Madarin Speaking skill is a Plus.
Strong client-facing communication skills and business understanding, with the ability to independently conduct requirement discovery, solution articulation, and value presentation.
Strong cross-functional collaboration capabilities, with the ability to coordinate product, R&D, algorithm, delivery, sales, and partner resources to drive complex projects to successful delivery.

2059142535267401728.RecruitPostName: 海外休闲IAP（二合）产品负责人
2059142535267401728.Responsibility:
团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。
Level Infinite为合作工作室提供一系列支持及服务，助力其释放产品潜能。
Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。
想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责
1. 产品全局把控： 主导休闲消除类游戏产品的整体方向和愿景，制定清晰的产品路线图和升级战略，确保从0到1的创意落地以及从1到N的持续迭代增长，实现产品代际跃升；
2. 跨部门协同： 密切与用户获取（UA）、市场发行、数据分析和商业化团队合作，根据海外市场的买量策略和增长机制及时调整产品方向；结合市场反馈和数据洞察，制定游戏运营活动、付费策略和功能更新计划，推动产品持续增长与长期留存；
3. 质量与进度负责： 把控游戏开发的关键里程碑和最终质量，对产品的品质、进度和预算负责；及时识别和解决项目风险和瓶颈，确保产品按计划上线并达到预期的用户满意度和商业目标；

岗位要求
1. 行业经验： 8年以上游戏开发从业经验，3年以上制作人/主策/产品负责人角色经验，深耕手机休闲游戏领域；
2. 产品类型成功经历： 拥有二合品类休闲游戏的成功项目经验，曾主导或深度参与过知名相关产品的开发或运营；项目月流水超过500万美金。
3. 发行思维： 深刻理解海外移动游戏市场的用户获取渠道和产品增长机制，熟悉买量投放、市场营销和商业化策略；具备数据驱动的思维方式，善于通过A/B测试和用户数据指导产品迭代，提高关键指标（留存、LTV等）；
4. 跨职能协作： 优秀的沟通协调能力，能够在产品、研发与运营等不同部门之间架起桥梁，并与用户获取、发行、营销、商业化等职能团队紧密协作，确保产品开发与市场策略步调一致；
5. 团队领导力： 出色的领导管理才能和人际沟通技巧，善于发掘和培养人才。曾经成功组建并管理过不少于10人的跨职能游戏开发或运营团队；能够在多元文化环境中工作，激励团队实现高绩效；
加分项：
1. 海外合作经验： 有与国际游戏工作室联合开发项目的经验者优先；了解海外合作方的工作方式，能有效管理时区差异和跨文化沟通；
2. 知名企业背景： 曾在国际或国内一流休闲游戏公司担任核心制作岗位者优先，对精品休闲手游的研发流程和品质要求有一线认知；
3. 全球发行经验： 有面向全球市场发行游戏的经验，熟悉海外各主要地区玩家偏好和市场趋势；曾主导产品获得海外市场成功者尤佳；
4. 激情与创新： 对休闲手游充满热情，关注最新的游戏玩法趋势和创新机制，拥有敏锐的市场洞察力和创造性思维，愿意大胆尝试将产品提升到新的高度。
5. 语言能力： 能够熟练地用英语进行沟通和报告，能够在跨国团队中协同工作，并有效地与海外合作伙伴进行交流更佳。

What the Role Entails
We are hiring an intern to work on evaluation and reliability infrastructure for a real-world LLM agent system in the UA performance marketing field. The agent performs multi-step reasoning, retrieves context, selects tools, executes actions, handles user confirmations, and interacts with external services.
The goal of this internship is to build transferable expertise in agent evaluation engineering: evaluating tool use, measuring trajectory quality, designing benchmarks, analyzing traces, comparing model and prompt variants, and improving the reliability of agentic AI systems.
This role is ideal for someone interested in future opportunities in LLM agent evaluation, AI safety evaluation, research engineering, LLMOps, or applied AI infrastructure.Research the state-of-the-art agentic workflow evaluation frameworks in the industry and in the research field.
Apply the theory to build automated evaluation pipelines that can run agent scenarios, capture execution artifacts, score results, and detect regressions.
Evaluate tool-use behavior, including whether the agent selects the right tool, passes correct arguments, avoids unnecessary calls, and handles tool errors appropriately.
Analyze agent trajectories using traces, logs, intermediate steps, and final outputs to identify reasoning failures, context misuse, hallucinated assumptions, and brittle workflow patterns.
Design metrics for agent reliability, including success rate, tool-call precision, argument accuracy, recovery rate, retry count, latency, cost, and safety-related failure rates.
Create reusable evaluation datasets from synthetic cases, golden workflows, and real anonymized executions.
Support experiments comparing prompts, model providers, tool descriptions, memory strategies, context construction methods, and execution modes.
Help build human evaluation workflows and rubrics for judging agent correctness, faithfulness, usefulness, and risk awareness.
Work with engineers to translate evaluation findings into better tests, monitoring signals, tool interfaces, prompts, and guardrails.
Potentially compose research papers and publish in scientific conferences.

Who We Look For
Currently pursuing or recent graduates of a Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
Strong Python fundamentals and interest in AI systems.
Curious about how LLM agents work, fail, and improve.
Interested in evaluation methodology, not just application building.
Comfortable reading logs, traces, test cases, and structured data.
Detail-oriented and able to define clear, measurable criteria for ambiguous agent behavior.
Prior experience with LLMs, LangChain-like agents, tool calling, pytest, data analysis, or observability tools is helpful but not required.

2052790938622935040.RecruitPostName: 广告推荐模型Infra算法专家
2052790938622935040.Responsibility:
随着广告业务的飞速发展，广告推荐模型正迎来新一轮的范式升级。我们将全面推进 Scaling Up（模型参数量级扩大 + 用户行为序列拉长），以期打破现有模型效果的天花板。
为了承接这一极具挑战的算法演进，我们正在打造新一代广告核心 Infra，全面拥抱原生 PyTorch 生态、全 GPU 训推链路以及基于 UV（User View）的高效样本训练模式等。
加入我们，你将主导这场技术变革，通过极致的算法和工程 Co-Design，大幅提升模型算法迭代效率，最终直接驱动公司营销业务核心 GMV 的增长。

1. 模型 Scaling Up：针对推荐大模型（超大参数量、超长序列特征等），设计并实现序列和非序列特征统一建模新范式。
2. 新一代架构演进：深度参与广告推荐系统核心 AI 基础设施（AI Infra）的设计与研发，推动从传统架构向基于原生 PyTorch 的新一代推荐训练/推理框架平滑升级。
3. 算法与工程 Co-Design：与底层 AI Infra 团队深度协同，深刻理解底层全 GPU 分布式训练（数据并行/模型并行/流水线并行）的特性，通过“算法适配算力”与“算力支撑算法”的双向优化，最大化模型迭代效率。
4. 业务赋能：深入理解广告推荐算法业务线（CTR/CVR预估等），通过底层工程架构和模型算法优化，提升模型实验效率，助力业务指标（收入、GMV等）达成。

About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.
We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
We are looking for an Associate Data Scientist to help build AI-powered capabilities for our influencer marketing platform. This role focuses on turning data and machine learning into practical product features—from creator discovery and content understanding to campaign optimization and performance prediction.
You will work at the intersection of data science, product, and engineering, helping bring intelligent systems into real world use cases that drive measurable business impact.
1. Applied AI & Model Development
Develop and deploy machine learning / AI models to enhance platform capabilities.
Work on use cases such as: 
Creator segmentation and recommendation.
Creator Content labeling and data analysis.
Campaign performance prediction and optimization. 
Agentic Systems Developing.

2. Problem Framing & Experimentation
Translate business and product problems into data science solutions.
Design experiments to validate hypotheses and measure impact.
Iterate on models based on performance, feedback, and real-world usage.

3. Data Pipeline & Feature Engineering
Work with data engineers to define and build scalable data pipelines.
Clean, process, and structure large datasets (creator data, content metadata, campaign performance).
Design meaningful features that improve model performance.

4. Product Integration
Collaborate closely with product managers and engineers to integrate models into the platform.
Ensure models are production-ready, reliable, and scalable.
Contribute to API design, model serving, and inference workflows.

5. Monitoring & Continuous Improvement
Track model performance using appropriate metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, business KPIs).
Maintain documentation and ensure reproducibility.

Who We Look For
Core Values
Integrity – You prioritize correctness, transparency, and responsible use of data.
Gamer Native – You understand gaming ecosystems and player/content dynamics.
Pop Culture Fluent – You are familiar with creators, platforms, and digital trends.
Tech-Savvy – You are curious and hands-on with emerging AI technologies.

Technical Skills
Strong foundation in machine learning and statistics.
Proficiency in Python and common ML libraries (e.g., PyTorch,scikit-learn).
Experience with data processing (e.g., pandas, SQL).
Familiarity with LLMs, NLP, or recommendation systems is a strong plus.
Understanding of model deployment (APIs, batch/real-time inference) is preferred.

Data & Product Thinking
Ability to translate ambiguous business problems into data science solutions.
Strong analytical thinking and hypothesis-driven approach.
Understanding of how models create value in a product context (not just offline metrics).

Execution & Collaboration
Ability to work cross-functionally with product, engineering, and business teams.
Good communication skills—able to explain complex models in simple terms.
Strong ownership and ability to iterate quickly.

Nice to Have
Experience in influencer marketing, advertising, or creator platforms.
Familiarity with social media data (e.g., YouTube, Twitch, TikTok ecosystems).
Experience with embeddings, vector databases, or retrieval systems.
Basic knowledge of data engineering or MLOps workflows.

Example Projects You Might Work On
Build a creator discovery engine using embeddings + similarity search.
Develop a content understanding pipeline (tags, sentiment, brand safety).
Train a campaign ROI prediction model to guide budget allocation. 
Integrate LLMs to improve tool efficiency and automate workflows.

What the Role Entails
Position Overview
Tencent Finance is seeking an experienced Senior Business Systems Analyst to join our Finance IT Management Department. This role serves as a strategic partner between Finance and Technology, responsible for the design, configuration, optimization, and support of enterprise financial and planning systems within a modern cloud environment.
The Senior Business Systems Analyst leads requirements discovery, translates business objectives into scalable system solutions, and drives continuous improvement across finance processes, integrations, data models, and reporting. The role ensures system stability, compliance, and long-term scalability while supporting enhancements, testing, and production operations in a fast-paced, global environment.
Primary Duties & Responsibilities:
Act as a subject matter expert across enterprise finance systems, supporting functional areas such as Financial Management, Procurement, Banking & Settlement, Projects, Expenses, and Supplier Management
Partner with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, develop conceptual and detailed solution designs, and configure systems to meet evolving business needs
Lead system configuration, testing, and deployment activities, supporting end-to-end delivery from design through go-live
Prepare detailed effort estimates, implementation plans, and testing strategies based on functional and technical requirements
Analyze, design, document, and validate system configurations supporting existing and new business processes, reporting, and data structures
Collaborate closely with finance leaders to understand business goals, identify gaps, and recommend system-driven improvements
Facilitate design reviews and solution walkthroughs with functional owners, subject matter experts, and end users
Present solution options with clear trade-offs, risks, and recommendations to support informed decision-making
Drive the delivery of system enhancements, new capabilities, and enterprise transformation initiatives
Participate in change management, user enablement, and post–go-live support activities

Who We Look For
Who We Are Looking For
Self-motivated, articulate, and results-driven, with a strong commitment to customer satisfaction
Passionate about delivering modern, cloud-based enterprise solutions that unlock business value
Comfortable balancing collaboration and independence in complex, fast-moving environments
Resourceful, proactive, and customer-focused, with a strong sense of ownership
Positive, adaptable, and dependable, able to perform effectively under tight timelines
Comfortable operating in dynamic, high-growth organizations
Qualifications
5+ years of experience working with enterprise financial or ERP platforms, including solution design, configuration, implementation, and production support (Workday Financials is strongly prefered)
Deep understanding of finance and planning domains, including core financial management, procure-to-pay, record-to-report, projects, expenses, and supplier management
Strong experience translating business and functional requirements into sustainable, scalable system solutions
Proven expertise across the full application development lifecycle, including design, testing, deployment, and support
Experience delivering large-scale ERP or enterprise cloud transformation initiatives
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; fluent in English (Mandarin is a plus but not required)
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
Ability to work effectively across geographies, time zones, and cross-functional teams
Experience integrating ERP or finance platforms with third-party systems
Demonstrated ability to adapt quickly to change and manage competing priorities
Strong technical project leadership and stakeholder management skills
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

1.5年及以上工作经验，有丰富的游戏经验，有网红推广、视频、直播、同人等内容创作经验者优先；

- Test the comfort, excitement, and strategic nature of combat and make improvements and adjustments based on player feedback.

- Prepare documents detailing the specifications of combat systems and related designs, organizing and communicating information clearly to other departments.
